To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The binding energies and the radii of nuclei in the region of stability are reasonably reproduced by the Vlasov approach using a simple momentum independent mean field; 2) The Vlasov approach with a momentum independent mean field is not able to reproduce binding energies of nuclei far from stability; 3) A momentum dependent mean field is able to reproduce the binding energies of nuclei in the stability region and of neutron rich nuclei.
